attributes.board_name: Puerto Rico Board of Nursing Examiners (Junta Examinadora de Enfermería, Departamento de Salud)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-authorized providers; PR residents must use Puerto Rico providers only (non-residents: at least 50%); PR certificates must carry a barcode; max 8 hours per day and 20 hours per certificate; any format (in person, online, journal, module)
rules.new_licensee_rule: A nurse receiving a permanent license for the first time is excused from the hours for the year of the triennium in which it was issued.
rules.legal_basis: Reglamento Núm. 9651 (Educación continua para la recertificación profesional de la enfermería); Ley Núm. 254 de 31 de diciembre de 2015
rules.notes: Covers generalist (BSN), associate (ADN) and specialist (master's) nurses; specialists need 6 of the 30 hours in their specialty. Plus 2 extra hours on 'Equidad y Respeto' (bioethics and anti-discrimination, Adm. Order 2024-583, since 2024). CE evidence is submitted with the recertification.
rules.rule_quote: Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Enfermeras Esp (29), Gen (30), Obs (32), Asoc (35) ➢ 30 horas Educación Continua.

rules.rule_quote: Requisitos de Renovación de licencia de Enfermera Práctica (34) ➢ 21 horas Educación Continua
